stem: Which of these lines from the poem helps the reader know what the word confounded means in line 7?

options.label: A
options.text: Bartholomew just wasn’t able to choose.

options.label: B
options.text: He’d go down to breakfast (a little bit smelly),

options.label: C
options.text: He’d end up with yesterday’s oatmeal instead.

options.label: D
options.text: Each hour would bring yet another decision . . .
